transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because everyone keeps acting like I’m making things up, but I’m not. My wife’s relative came into the house to get at me. My tools don’t just move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. This has been going on for months, and it’s clear to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you think other people are involved in this plot against you, or is it just your wife's relative?

I think he’s the one behind it. Other people might be looking the other way, but it’s him coming into my house, messing with my tools, spoiling my fishing plans. It’s been going on long enough that I can see what he’s trying to do—take over my place and push me out.
Do you think there's any chance you could be mistaken about your wife's relative doing these things?

No. I don’t think I’m mistaken. Everybody keeps saying I’m imagining it, but I know what’s happening. My tools don’t move by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend for no reason. After all these months, it’s plain to me he’s coming into the house to get at me and trying to push me out.
Do you think your wife's relative is using any unusual or supernatural methods to try to get at you and push you out?

No, I’m not saying it’s supernatural or anything like that. I’m saying he’s coming into the house and messing with my things. My tools don’t move by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. That’s what I mean—he’s trying to get at me and push me out.
Do you think there's anything that could change your mind about your wife's relative being behind these events?

I don’t know what could change my mind at this point. I mean, I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but I know what’s been going on. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s plain to me he’s been coming into the house to get at me, trying to take over my place and push me out.
How long have you believed that your wife's relative is trying to take over your place and push you out?
About nine months now. It started after my wife’s relative moved into our home, and since then it’s just kept going.
Do you think about your wife's relative plotting against you all the time, or are there times when you don't think about it?

It’s not every single second, no. If I’m working or busy with something, I can put it aside for a while. But it comes back because things keep happening, and I know he’s behind it. My tools don’t move by themselves, and those fishing plans getting spoiled over and over—that’s not just bad luck. After all these months, it’s pretty plain to me he’s trying to push me out.
Do you think there's anything else going on that's not quite right, besides what's happening with your wife's relative?
Not that I can think of. I mean, the main thing is what’s been happening with him. I haven’t noticed anything else that seems off like that.
Would you say that the idea of your wife's relative trying to take over your place and push you out is something that most people would find hard to believe?

I guess most people say it’s hard to believe, yeah. That’s why I’m here—everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it. But I know what I’ve seen. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. He came into that house to get at me, and after all these months it’s plain to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you have any other thoughts or beliefs that you think might be hard for others to understand?

No, not really anything else. It’s mainly this thing with my wife’s relative. I know other people don’t understand it, and they keep saying I’m imagining it, but I’m not. My tools don’t move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get messed up every weekend for no reason. To me it’s plain—he came into the house to get at me and push me out.
How much of your daily thoughts are taken up by thinking about your wife's relative trying to take over your place and push you out?

A lot of it, honestly. It’s on my mind most of the day, especially when I’m at home. I keep thinking about what he’s moved, what he’s planning next, how he’s trying to push me out. I try to do other things, but it comes right back because it’s happening right in front of me.
Do you think your belief about your wife's relative would change if you had proof that he wasn't involved in these events?

I don’t know what kind of proof would change it, honestly. People keep telling me I’m imagining it, but I know what’s been going on. My tools don’t just move by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s plain to me he came into that house to get at me and push me out.
Have your thoughts about your wife's relative trying to take over your place and push you out ever changed or wavered since you first started believing it?

No, not really. If anything, it’s gotten clearer to me over time. At first maybe I was trying to make sense of it, but after months of my tools being moved and my fishing plans getting spoiled every weekend, I don’t see how that’s just nothing. I know people think I’m imagining it, but I’m not. To me it’s plain he came into the house to get at me and push me out.
Do you think it's possible for you to be wrong about your wife's relative trying to take over your place and push you out?

No, I don’t really think I’m wrong about it. I know everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining things, but my tools don’t just move by themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend for no reason. After all these months, it’s plain to me he came into that house to get at me and push me out.
Have you ever considered the possibility that your wife's relative is not actually doing these things, but rather you are mistakenly attributing them to him?

I’ve considered it because people keep saying that, but no, I don’t believe that’s what’s happening. I’m here because everybody acts like I’m imagining it, but I know what I’ve seen. My tools don’t just move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s plain to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people cannot hear?
No, I don’t hear voices or sounds like that. Not that I’ve noticed, anyway.
Do you ever find it hard to express your thoughts or get your point across to others?
Not really. I mean, I can explain myself fine most of the time. Maybe people don’t like what I’m saying, or they don’t believe me, but I don’t think it’s because I can’t get the words out.
Do you ever find yourself jumping from one idea to another when talking, without finishing your initial thought?
I don’t think so. I might get worked up sometimes and have a lot to say, but I don’t feel like I’m jumping all over the place or leaving thoughts unfinished.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts are disjointed or hard to put into words when you're trying to explain what's happening with your wife's relative?
No, I don’t think my thoughts are disjointed. I know what I’m trying to say. It’s just that it’s hard to get people to understand or take it seriously when I talk about him. But the words are there.
